jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
We currently have an opportunity for an HSE and Prevention Manager

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The HSE and Prevention Manager is responsible for defining, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the company's HSE strategy in accordance with Belgian legislation and Safran Group SSE standards. The role acts as the legally designated Prevention Advisor and leads the HSE team.
In order to ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment you will:

• Manage the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of health, safety, environmental, and prevention programs.
• Act as Prevention Advisor under Belgian legislation.
• Develop and deploy HSE strategy, policies and procedures.
• Conduct risk assessments and maintain prevention plans.
• Lead HSE training, awareness and culture initiatives.
• Conduct audits, inspections and compliance monitoring.
• Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.
• Manage emergency preparedness, first aid and fire prevention.
• Participate in CPPT/CPBW and advise management.
• Ensure environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives.
• Lead and develop the HSE team.

Your profile:

• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You hold a Master's degree in Engineering or Safety & Health, or a related technical or scientific field.
• You are a Certified Prevention Advisor (Level 1) or Safety Coordinator.
• You have a strong interest in improving workplace safety and wellbeing with a preventive mindset.
• You have experience or strong exposure to manufacturing or supply chain environments, with a solid understanding of workshop activities and safety challenges.
• You have strong planning and coordination skills, and you have a practical and problem‑solving mindset.
• You have experience in developing and implementing training programs, and in evaluating the effectiveness of HSE processes, programs, and procedures.
• You are familiar with risk assessments and safety audits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or a valid work and residence permit). Please note that visa sponsorship is not available.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.description:
Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. You will coordinate shipments with factories and be an integral part of the team based in Brecht, handling orders for the US market. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
• Review incoming customer orders for items, pricing, and export license requirements. 
 
• Process sales orders in the ERP system (SAP) using the ESKER tool. 
 
• Process purchase orders at manufacturing plants, if required. 
 
• Follow up on sales orders with manufacturing plants and warehouses to ensure timely delivery. 
 
• Communicate with customers regarding their orders; resolve delivery issues, respond to inquiries, and provide necessary delivery documentation. 
 
• Request export documentation from customers as needed. 
 
• Invoice customers after delivery and monitor customer balances prior to shipment. 
 
• Maintain and closely monitor order backlog. 
 
• Record orders and customer information in internal systems and files. 
 
• Serve as a backup for other Sales Operations Specialists when needed. 

 
• A college Diploma or equivalent required, AS or higher in business preferred. 
 
• A first experience in Customer service - Order Processing is required. 
 
• A very good and professional command of English is required. In addition, you also have a good command of German. 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively: strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 
• Flexible, easy-going and able to adapt to a fast-paced and sometimes changing environment. 
 
• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and complete tasks on time. 
 
• Focused and versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure. 
 
• Detail oriented with high level of accuracy. 
 
• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. 
 
• Self-motivated and good level of focus/concentration. 
 
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
• Strong computer skills and experience with SAP. 
 
• You have your own transportation and a valid driving license (difficult to reach by public transport).
